topic: How to turn your teen's screen time into skill-building time
caption:
Your teen is already spending hours online. The question is whether those hours are building anything.

Pick one thing they do well on a screen and search what people charge for it on Fiverr. Video editing teens are earning $15 to $50 per project.

One conversation this week could shift everything.
